description: This file implements a command palette dialog component for the Notesnook application, including search, command execution, and UI rendering logic.

classes.name: CommandPaletteDialog
classes.description: A React component for the command palette dialog, managing search, command execution, and UI interactions.

methods.name: getNextCommandIndex
methods.description: Calculates the next index for command selection, wrapping around the list.

methods.name: getPreviousCommandIndex
methods.description: Calculates the previous index for command selection, wrapping around the list.

methods.name: commandSearch
methods.description: Performs fuzzy search on commands based on the query.

methods.name: useDatabaseFuzzySearch
methods.description: Custom hook for searching notes, notebooks, tags, and reminders with fuzzy matching.

methods.name: getSessionsAsCommands
methods.description: Retrieves recent commands and open sessions as command objects.

methods.name: calculateCommandItemLocation
methods.description: Custom scroll positioning logic for command palette items to ensure smooth navigation.

methods.name: getCommandPaletteHelp
methods.description: Provides help key hints based on command mode.

methods.name: sortCommands
methods.description: Sorts commands by group, placing recent commands at the top.
